title: The derivative of the fractional discrete Laplacian is an exotic Riesz potential
summary: Let $Δ_{N}$ be the multidimensional discrete Laplacian on $\mathbb{Z}^N$ ($N\ge1$). In this note, we prove that, when $N=1$, the right hand derivative of $(-Δ_1)^s$ at $0$ is an exotic discrete Riesz potential (namely, the endpoint case: the order is 0) in Stein-Wainger sense (J. Anal. Math. 2000), and when $N\ge 2$, the corresponding derivative is also an exotic discrete Riesz potential with an additional corrector.
